'''Cress's Panpour''' (Japanese: '''コーンのヒヤップ''' ''Corn's Hiyappu'') is the only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} [[Cress]] is known to have in {{aniseries|BW}}.

==In animation==
===''Pokémon the Series''===
===={{aniseries|BW}}====
=====Unova=====
[[File:Cress and Panpour.png|thumb|left|250px|Panpour and Cress]]
Cress received his Panpour at a young age when his brothers were also given their first Pokémon. It debuted in ''[[BW005|Triple Leaders, Team Threats!]]'', where Cress introduced it to {{Ash}}, who scanned it with his [[Pokédex]] before battling.

Panpour was the second Pokémon Ash faced in his [[Striaton City]] [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}, where it went up against [[Ash's Pikachu]]. Panpour's Double Team confused Pikachu, after which Panpour landed a powerful Scratch. Pikachu tried to use {{m|Thunderbolt}}, but Panpour's Water Gun hit Pikachu before he could execute his move. Pikachu then tried to use {{m|Volt Tackle}}, but Panpour's Mud Sport stopped Pikachu in his tracks, after which another Water Gun knocked him out.

Panpour reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[BW058|A Call for Brotherly Love!]]'' and ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]''.

=====Decolore Islands=====
[[File:Elemental Monkeys anime.png|thumb|240px|right|Panpour, Pansage, and Pansear]]
Prior to ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]'', Panpour battled [[Morana]] and her {{p|Glalie}}. It attempted to use Scratch, though its opponent dodged and struck it with {{m|Headbutt}}. Its Water Gun was then overpowered by {{m|Water Pulse}}, which hit Panpour hard, and it was knocked out by Glalie's {{m|Sheer Cold}}. Later in the episode, Panpour greeted [[Cilan's Pansage]], alongside [[Chili's Pansear]], and cheered him on during his battle with Morana's {{p|Abomasnow}}.

====Personality and characteristics====
Panpour is generally friendly and loves to battle. It is very determined to do its best in any circumstance. It is a very powerful and adept battler, able to defeat [[Ash's Pikachu]] without taking a single hit despite the type disadvantage with counters and attacks that were vicious, speedy, and above all disorientating. Panpour is also shown to have a close relationship with [[Cilan's Pansage]] and [[Chili's Pansear]], as the three happily greeted one another upon being reunited in ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]''.

===Pokémon Adventures===
[[File:Cress Simipour Adventures.png|140px|thumb|Cress's Simipour in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]]
[[File:Cress Panpour Adventures.png|115px|thumb|As a Panpour]]
Simipour first appeared as a Panpour. It assists Cress and his brothers in the kitchen by pouring water for tea for their customers. Simipour, as a Panpour, first appeared in ''[[PS469|Welcome to Striaton City!!]]'', with its Trainer at the [[Striaton Gym]] where it helped prepare tea for {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|Cheren}} and {{adv|Bianca}}.

[[PS470|Later]], it was used in the Gym battle against Black, Cheren, and Bianca alongside Cress's brothers' Pokémon. They proved powerful against Black's [[Tep]], [[Bianca's Oshawott]] and [[Cheren's Snivy]] with their type advantages. Although it managed to defeat Tep, he managed to revive its fallen teammates with some healing leaves that were previously knocked off of {{TP|Cilan|Pansage}}'s head. With [[Chili's Pansear]] defeated, the challengers won the match when the time limit ends due to them having three Pokémon able to battle while the Gym Leaders only had two.

In ''[[PS515|The Shadow Triad]]'', Panpour was used to battle the [[Shadow Triad]] at the [[P2 Lab]]. Although it, Pansage, and Pansear were at a disadvantage against their opponents, their Trainers gave them a boost of power by [[Evolution|evolving]] them with their respective [[Water Stone|Evolution stone]]. Panpour evolves into a Simipour, but is still unable to defeat its opponent despite becoming stronger. Eventually, they are saved by {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Cobalion}}, {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Terrakion}}, and {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Virizion}}, who attacked both groups to rescue the [[Kelden|Keldeo]] the Shadow Triad had captured.
